subject: Eligibility: DataBridge delegated S3 ingest & vector tier partnership
messages:
From: Elena Gomez <elena@databridge.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request — delegated S3 ingest for vector tier

Hi Rafael,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. DataBridge is ready to run a small delegated ingest pilot that streams user documents into a cold S3-backed vector tier and routes hot queries to Pinecone. Before we align engineers, the security and partner eligibility team asked for a short checklist and any required MoA/commercial pre-approvals.

Attached is a short one-pager on expected payloads and an architecture sketch. High-level asks:
- Can Redwood accept delegated S3 ingest where DataBridge pushes objects to a pre-signed ingest bucket?
- Minimum throughput per partner (MB/s and QPS) and any storage lifecycle expectations?
- Any data residency constraints or KMS requirements?

We can share SOC2 evidence and a redlined MOA. Would you prefer a quick 30-min sync to run through the checklist or should we send docs first?

Attachments: db_ingest_security_brief.pdf (security brief), s3-ingest-arch.drawio (diagram)

Thanks,
Elena Gomez
Head of Partnerships | DataBridge Inc
elena@databridge.io
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Gomez <elena@databridge.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — delegated S3 ingest for vector tier

Hi Elena — great to get this. Appreciate the diagram and brief. Short answers up front: yes, we support delegated S3 ingest patterns, but we have a small eligibility checklist we run through (security, throughput, PKI/KMS, and routing fallbacks).

Before we schedule engineering, could you confirm the following so we can route to the right teams: 
1) Data residency: which region(s) will the data originate from (US/EU/APAC)?
2) Expected peak ingest rate (MB/s) and average QPS for retrieval requests (30/60/second bucket)?
3) KMS: will you bring your own KMS/HSM or need Redwood-managed keys for the ingest bucket?
4) Retention: expected TTL/archival policy for vector blobs in cold S3.

If you can send answers + SOC2 report, we can fast-track a partner MoA. Monica (cc) will own the security review; Ben will scope the runtime throughput. If you prefer a short sync, I can book 30 minutes on Wed morning.

I attached our partner-eligibility-template for you to fill (we can also accept answers inline).

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
Attachment referenced: partner-eligibility-template.xlsx
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — delegated S3 ingest for vector tier (internal)

Rafael / Laura / Ben — quick internal note after an initial look at the brief:
- SOC2 + sigs good; need a completed partner-eligibility-template with KMS answers (BYOK vs Redwood-managed) before we sign off.
- If they use BYOK, we need to validate KMS rotation schedule and cross-account key policies (security ops takes ~5 business days for that review).
- Throughput: if >100MB/s sustained we'll want an uplift for dedicated capacity (Dedicated or burst) to meet latency SLOs. Ben, can you estimate cost delta for a 100MB/s sustained ingest for 30 days?

Laura — this will likely need a standard Partner MoA (no special credits ask yet). If approved, we can push for a canary in US-west and validate spillover to eu-west.

Monica
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Gomez <elena@databridge.io>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 18:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot request — delegated S3 ingest for vector tier

Thanks team — attaching the signed MoA and a short answers sheet. Summary answers:
- Regions: US-west primary, EU as backup (we will mark EU objects with region tag).
- Peak ingest: 60MB/s peak, ~20MB/s sustained. Retrieval QPS: ~40 QPS during business hours.
- KMS: we will use our corporate KMS (BYOK) and can provide cross-account policy.
- Retention: 90 days hot in vector tier, then archive to cold S3 with 365-day retention.

Attachments: signed-moa-databridge.pdf, db_ingest_security_brief.pdf (updated)
DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/rs/signed/abcdef123456

If this looks fine, please confirm the eligibility sign-off and we will schedule engineering pairing for 1 Oct.

Best,
Elena Gomez
Head of Partnerships | DataBridge Inc
elena@databridge.io
